# olivares_deployment (Resource)

Desired state of an agent/MCP deployment in the Olivares AI control plane (module VII). Declaring this resource records desired state only; reconciling it to real infrastructure is a separate, human-in-the-loop-governed action in the engine and is never triggered by terraform apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Declares DESIRED STATE only. Reconciling it to real infrastructure is a
# separate, human-in-the-loop-governed action in the engine — never triggered by
# terraform apply.
resource "olivares_deployment" "billing_prod" {
  subject_kind = "agent"
  subject_ref  = olivares_agent.billing.id
  name         = "billing-prod"
  environment  = "prod"
  runtime      = "k8s"
  target       = "k8s.namespace/prod"
  source_ref   = "git:github.com/acme/agents#main"

  spec = jsonencode({
    image     = "ghcr.io/acme/billing-agent:1.4.2"
    resources = { cpu = "500m", memory = "512Mi" }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment` (String) Deployment environment (e.g. "prod", "staging"). Immutable.
- `name` (String) Logical deployment name, unique per environment. Immutable.
- `runtime` (String) Executor/runtime kind (e.g. "docker", "k8s"). Immutable.
- `spec` (String) The desired-state spec as a JSON document (image/command/resources/env_refs/wirings/identity). Secrets are referenced by secret_ref only — never cleartext.
- `subject_kind` (String) What is deployed: "agent" or "mcp_server". Immutable (changing it replaces the resource).
- `subject_ref` (String) Logical reference of the deployed subject. Immutable.
- `target` (String) Runtime target reference from the inventory (e.g. "docker.host/node1", "k8s.namespace/prod").

### Optional

- `source_ref` (String) GitOps source reference (e.g. "git:<repo>#<commit>"). Never a credential.
- `tenant` (String) Tenant UUID for this resource, overriding the provider-level tenant. Sent as X-Olivares-Tenant.

### Read-Only

- `applied_version` (Number) Revision actually reconciled to infrastructure (real); 0 = never applied.
- `current_version` (Number) Latest declared revision number (desired).
- `desired_status` (String) Desired lifecycle status as resolved by the engine ("active"/"retired").
- `id` (String) Server-assigned definition ID.
- `spec_hash` (String) Hex SHA-256 of the current desired spec, as computed by the engine.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import olivares_deployment.billing_prod dpl_01HX...
```
